chapter: Early career: vaudeville and Kansas City
title: Music as the road into show business
summary: A somewhat muddled exchange in which Basie says music was how he got into show business and that he wanted to be part of it, traveling and with a carnival.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows
